links.outcome: Readability of AI-simplified radiology reports (Flesch Reading Ease) versus original reports
links.effect: Readability improved markedly (Flesch Reading Ease 49.2→73); readability/tone rubric score 4.9 ± 0.32.

links.outcome: Radiologist review of AI-simplified report outputs for accuracy and completeness
links.effect: Accuracy 4.77 ± 0.62; core diagnostic completeness attained in all patients; 92% of reports released 'as is'.
links.quote: 92% percent of reports were released 'as is.

unlisted_practices: Iterative prompt refinement across five prompt versions with a standard disclaimer to improve simplification quality
Bilingual (English and Hindi) simplification pipeline for radiology reports

screen.reason: The study develops and validates a custom pipeline (Vernacular Language Converter based on Gemini 2.5 Pro) to simplify oncology radiology reports into patient-friendly English and Hindi, evaluated by expert radiologists on retrospective/de-identified reports.
